The walls are made of wood and there are rows of bookshelves on the left side of the image. On the right side, there is a tall spiral staircase with a glass railing. In the center of the staircase, there are several orange chairs and tables with people sitting at them. The people in the image appear to be engaged in conversation and browsing the books. The overall atmosphere of the library is cozy and inviting.
